newsitem.title: USA: Herbalife insiders sell as shrs fall - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Herbalife insiders sell as shrs fall - WSJ.

text.p: While the shares of Herbalife Inc have fallen recently from all-time highs, insiders have sold shares, the Wall Street Journal said in Wednesday's electronic edition.

According to recent filings with the Federal Filings Business News, the newspaper said the company's chairman, chief operating officer and another director sold a total of 269,750 shares over an 11-day period in March.
During that time, Herbalife shares fell 18 percent, the Journal said.

This month, another company insider, a former director and vice president who retired but is still a consultant to Herbalife, indicated he planned to sell 20,000 shares in papers filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the newspaper said.
On April 11, Herbalife said its board authorized a new repurchase program for up to $30 million of its common stock.
Herbalife was not immediately available to comment.
